title: Metal
doc: The conductor family: fully metallic, mid roughness, iron's reflectance as the neutral conductor.

provenance.source: Lagarde and de Rousiers, Moving Frostbite to Physically Based Rendering (SIGGRAPH 2014 course), table of measured conductor reflectances
provenance.note: base_color is iron's linear F0 (0.56, 0.57, 0.58) rounded to two decimals
base_metalness 1 by definition of the family; specular_roughness 0.4 chosen as a mid value
